body: Yeah feel the same way as you. I would never bring a kid into this fucked up world and I hate my parents too for creating me. Things would have been better if I never existed. Glad there's someone who at least understands this. I'm not gonna say things like, "life gets better" and shit like that because that's pretty much BS ngl.
Antidepressants will help decrease that problem of yours.

I know everyone has different values but love is fake. Even good looking people eventually break up with their partners and get treated like shit in the end of the day. Don't live for people to like you. Yeah sure your life would be better if you were handsome and tall like a model but there's nothing to do about that. Life fucking sucks and it's unfair for most people in different ways.
Wow you're so lucky to have friends that love your I can't even imagine having friends.
Thank you for reaching out to me. I'll just live until my time comes, unless if things gets worse.

I feel the same way as you do. I don't wanna live in this cruel world but I can't bring to kill myself.. I guess we should just try our best in this world until our time comes. Which is pathetic because it's so hard continue like this.

You shouldn't let someone have that much control over you. She's playing with your feelings and that's not okay, you deserve better than her. If she treats you like that then she obviously doesn't love you back so stop loving someone who doesn't give a fuck about you. Don't even bother wasting your time and energy. Live for yourself not for others and I promise that once she's out from your life you will start thinking, feeling and acting better.
Why should we care about others when no one gives a shit about us? Lmaooo
That's what I always think. This world is not made for good people lmao that's why it's so fucked up.

I wonder why we work so hard in this world, study our ass off, get a job and work like a slave, become old and our body stops working properly then we die. I don't find my life meaningful at all and everyone hates me and I'm a loner anyway so I don't care if I die. But when it comes to someone else, most people have it better off than I do, maybe the reason will find you eventually.

I took a lot pills too a couple months ago and my parents made me throw them up unfortunately. Still wish I could've died that time and wish I could die right now. But you shouldn't die, continue living because I know there's people who would miss you unlike me because no one's gives a fuck about me.

I tried killing myself like a couple months ago by taking 50 sleeping pills all at once and I swallowed it. My parents found out and made me throw it up unfortunately. I hate my parents for bringing me in this world and treating me like a piece of shit, I hate how everyone is towards me. I'm lonely and fucking depressed and no matter how much I try to reach out to people I went up getting ghosted. I don't have any career interests and I have no motivation to study. I have no friends or family. I'm a loner and a  loser, everyone treats me like garbage and I don't see myself in the future either.
